latest_release.name: Release v1.7.2 Hotfix 2
latest_release.body:
> [!IMPORTANT]  
> 该版本修改了部分插件接口  
> 部分插件可能无法正常使用  
> 如果你介意请等待插件开发者适配后再更新到该版本

> [!TIP]  
> 如果你是插件开发者可以参阅[插件迁移文档](https://music.moekoe.cn/guide/migrate-plugin-to-1.7.2)

## What's Changed
* feat: realize report and sync listen time by @LateDreamXD in https://github.com/MoeKoeMusic/MoeKoeMusic/pull/1206
* feat: 实现 macOS 关闭窗口后隐藏 Dock 图标 by @No-World in https://github.com/MoeKoeMusic/MoeKoeMusic/pull/1213
* feat(api): built api into electron client by @LateDreamXD in https://github.com/MoeKoeMusic/MoeKoeMusic/pull/1217
* feat(electron/extensions): add `apiMode` permission to start api service automatically for extensions needs by @LateDreamXD in https://github.com/MoeKoeMusic/MoeKoeMusic/pull/1223
* chore(deps): bump most of deps by @LateDreamXD in https://github.com/MoeKoeMusic/MoeKoeMusic/pull/1225
* docs: add some checkboxs to issue templates and remove api build for linux arm64 in readme by @LateDreamXD in https://github.com/MoeKoeMusic/MoeKoeMusic/pull/1232
* chore(deps): bump kugoumusicapi to 1.6.3 by @LateDreamXD in https://github.com/MoeKoeMusic/MoeKoeMusic/pull/1235
* fix:修复插件脚本在冷启动时概率性未注入 by @Yngu196 in https://github.com/MoeKoeMusic/MoeKoeMusic/pull/1238
* fix(kugouapi): request lyric return empty by @LateDreamXD in https://github.com/MoeKoeMusic/MoeKoeMusic/pull/1242
* feat(kugouapi): reset device cant be call in extensions by @LateDreamXD in https://github.com/MoeKoeMusic/MoeKoeMusic/pull/1245
* revert(frontend): use legacy method to decide way to request api by @LateDreamXD in https://github.com/MoeKoeMusic/MoeKoeMusic/pull/1247
* release(1.7.2): publish moekoe music 1.7.2 by @LateDreamXD in https://github.com/MoeKoeMusic/MoeKoeMusic/pull/1248
* fix(request): call `hasBuiltinApi()` in other request methods by @LateDreamXD in https://github.com/MoeKoeMusic/MoeKoeMusic/pull/1251
* fix(extensions): can not show settings button when has popup by @LateDreamXD in https://github.com/MoeKoeMusic/MoeKoeMusic/pull/1256


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/MoeKoeMusic/MoeKoeMusic/compare/v1.7.1...v1.7.2
